reason: $30 a month is too much for me when a big bottle of magnesium costs about $12 and lasts longer. The lab report is a good thing, but I would not pay triple for it, and I forget my vitamins half the time anyway.
objection: Why pay $30 for one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule for less? I am paying for the sachet, not for anything better inside.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for 30 days, or a lab report that shows it is clearly better than the cheap bottles.
